# Web App Delivery Planner

## Purpose
Create a practical delivery plan for a small client web application or website feature.

## Workflow
1. Record target users, core user journeys, required pages, supported devices, languages, and success criteria.
2. Distinguish must-have scope from optional enhancements and identify content or design assets the client must provide.
3. Map UI, API, data storage, authentication, and third-party dependencies; mark unknown hosting limits and costs explicitly.
4. Define accessibility, responsive behavior, privacy, input validation, authorization, and error-state requirements.
5. Split delivery into milestones with demonstrable acceptance criteria and review points.
6. Specify unit, integration, end-to-end, accessibility, and security checks appropriate to the scope.
7. Prepare deployment, rollback, documentation, ownership, and maintenance handoff requirements without deploying.

## Output
Requirements brief, page and journey inventory, architecture outline, milestone plan, test matrix, risk register, and handoff checklist.

## Safety and limits
- Planning only; do not deploy, modify DNS, collect real user data, or create accounts.
- Do not assume free hosting, domains, databases, or commercial-use rights.
- No runtime activation or tool grants.

CEOAI-authored workflow. Delivery planning only.
